purpose: Give web pages one normalized projection shape so V4/next clients render the same authoritative knowledge, provenance, boundaries, media and cross-product links without embedding a second source of truth in page code.

render_gates.when: evidence_state=unsupported AND claim is external factual/legal/technical
render_gates.action: do not render as established fact; show review-needed state or use only independently valid internal policy wording
warn/withhold freshness-sensitive claim until source recheck
require boundary metadata and qualification-sensitive qualifiers; media must meet safety-review gate
do not expose as ordinary public learner content
render outbound Production Atlas link/summary contract; do not copy current employer/opening/pay records into Crew Blueprint payload
label provenance/version and do not imply current publication status

home.intent: small decision set; route learner by goal

field.rule: online practice does not equal employer authorization

grow.rule: completion does not appoint learner to a role

sources.rule: matrix projection replaces hand-maintained source lists as final authority

known_v4_projection_debt: content.js contains hand-maintained sourceGroups separate from the normalized matrix; treat as presentation-era data, not canonical provenance.

The Production Atlas sourceGroups link points at a GitHub main-branch path while the ecosystem relationship map names research-version as Atlas canonical research branch; replace hard-coded branch assumptions with stable Atlas route IDs/URLs.
V4 programs are presentation bundles; they need canonical CONTENT/COMPETENCY joins before evidence-complete status can be inferred.
sources-v4.html must eventually render a generated/local projection of canonical source/claim state rather than rely on a static bibliography list.
client_invariants: one canonical content identity may appear in multiple learner journeys without copy/paste divergence
source panel and course body must resolve the same claim IDs
progress/view state is separate from knowledge completion, assessment, observed practice and external authorization
public clients never receive private Roadmapdev personal/worker records
all cross-product links are compatibility checked and fail visibly if superseded
